plugin.name: dimaround
plugin._long: Dims everything behind the focused floating window, similar to Hyprland's dimaround rule.

option.name: opacity
option._long: Opacity of the black overlay drawn behind the focused floating window.

option.name: app_ids
option._long: Space or comma separated list of app-ids for which the dimming applies. Use * for all floating windows.

option.name: disabled_during
option._long: Space or comma separated list of plugins (e.g. scale expo) during which the dimming is turned off.
